items: Grok is now available as a model provider, alongside Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity.
CAGR measurements also show the number of bars and the elapsed time of the selected range.
Fixed scheduled sessions that read earlier transcripts growing until the backend ran out of memory.
Charts have a CAGR tool to measure growth, volatility, price return and Sharpe over a selected time range.
Saved scripts can be added directly to the selected chart from the indicator library.
Watchlists can run AI research for each symbol and show the answers in custom columns.
Fixed hidden indicator outputs affecting their panel's automatic scale.
Fixed Shift-wheel direction for vertical-axis zoom and horizontal chart scrolling.
Hide individual indicator outputs and edit each output's color and style in Series settings.
Watchlists highlight changed digits in live prices and Formula values.
Indicator and watchlist Formula symbol inputs now open the symbol picker.
Fixed Workspace files reopening with stale text after changes on disk.
Fixed busy live charts requiring repeated resyncs and replaying every tick when returning to a dashboard.
Fixed Codex subagent follow-ups losing replies or failing on tool calls.
Ask the Agent to build custom dashboard widgets, or write and publish them from Workspace.
Watchlists now support Formula columns with configurable indicator outputs, parameters, and bar settings.
Measure price changes, bar counts, elapsed time, and volume from the chart toolbar or with Shift-click.
Drag shared dashboard dividers to resize adjacent widgets; watchlist symbols stay visible as you scroll.
Comparison symbols now default to candlesticks with distinct colors.
Fixed native Agent runs stopping during quiet periods and losing completed work after a failure.
Browse one workspace at a time, preview files with Quick Look, and open documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, and media.
Click a watchlist symbol or press Enter to show it in the dashboard's chart.
Watchlists now show price history sparklines; hover to compare every row at the same time.
OpenChart now checks for new releases at startup and every 10 minutes.
Ask the Agent to collect CSV data, plot it on charts, and refresh it on demand or on a schedule.
Add watchlists to dashboards with nested sections, sortable quotes, and configurable columns.
Cloud charts in Extended or 24 hr mode now shade pre-market and after-hours sessions.
Fixed incomplete Yahoo Finance data appearing complete; live charts retry failed updates automatically.
Dashboards now allow one widget of each kind; extra widgets move to new dashboards without losing saved charts.
Watchlist and alert symbols now use full-size logo images.
You can now use OpenChart without signing in; sign in from the sidebar when you want OpenChart Cloud.
Settings → Data Providers offers Sign in for OpenChart Cloud instead of an error while you're signed out.
Fixed deleting the open dashboard getting stuck on Deleting… or ending on a load error.
Opening a deleted dashboard now says it's no longer available, with a link home.
New chart tours show how to change intervals, tune studies and create indicators with the Agent.
Open Indicators or add a Workspace widget to see how to convert Pine Script into a chart indicator.
New installs ask to enable notifications before starting the dashboard tour.
Fixed provider sign-in failures leaving expired links and instructions on screen.
Fixed symbol searches failing when distinct listings share the same symbol and venue.
Fixed Markdown tables with empty cells opening in Source instead of the visual editor.
Saved alerts have an Events tab with each trigger's history and links to the sessions it started.
Interval, session and adjustment choices your data source lacks now show a lock and offer OpenChart Cloud.
New installs include two editable example studies in My scripts, and clicking a script opens its file.
Suggested prompts in new chats now finish their work without stopping for follow-up questions.
Fixed live Cloud charts stopping after an interval change, and charts that wouldn't reload after panning too far.
Fixed scripts failing to find Yahoo Finance symbols, and neutral agent annotations hidden in the light theme.
OpenChart Cloud adds US stock, ETF and crypto data; subscribe or redeem an invite in Settings → Subscription.
The indicator library previews every study on real market history, with how to read it and its inputs.
Add Volume Profile from the chart menu and Session Volume Profile from the library, with their own bars and colors.
Antigravity joins Claude Code and Codex as a model provider, and the model picker offers Sonnet 5.5 and Sol 6.1.
New installs start with a short tour, and new chats suggest prompts to start from.
Fixed symbol search hiding exact matches, and error messages hidden behind open dialogs.
Feed posts show attachments in a carousel, with live read-only charts opened at the alert.
Give an agent a new instruction from any Feed post and follow its reply in Copilot.
The Feed loads older posts as you scroll, and links in agent posts open the rule or dashboard.
Chats show a blue dot when a finished run hasn't been read yet.
New installs open a sample Bitcoin dashboard with alerts.
Fixed Copy buttons in the desktop app and chart errors when Yahoo has no data for older dates.
Build dashboards from chart, workspace and alert widgets, with Copilot aware of what you're viewing.
Create alerts on chart indicators, open their code beside charts, and reload edits when ready.
Existing chart indicators must be added again after this update.
Alerts show monitoring interruptions and notify you after 60 seconds while the app is running.
Workflows are editable Workspace files, and large workspaces load faster.
Fixed link previews appearing behind Copilot and MACD bars using the same color above and below zero.
Create alerts from the sidebar and edit conditions, code, notifications and Agent actions.
Chart drawing alerts support channels, Fibonacci levels, curves and freehand paths.
Feed brings alert events and Agent posts together, including images, audio and video.
View schedules on a calendar and create alerts or schedules with your Copilot.
Run research workflows and ask Agents to explain chart selections using real market data.
Preview cited links, sort sidebar lists and choose alert notification sounds in Settings.
Error messages now close on their own after a few seconds instead of piling up.
A ready update now appears as a button beside your account instead of a dialog.
Settings → Changelog lists what changed in each release.
Settings → Models installs Codex and Claude Code for you and walks through signing in.
Codex and Claude Code follow the new Permissions setting: Ask, Auto, or Always allow (the default).
GPT-6 Sol and Luna are available, and Claude models now show full names such as Opus 5.5.
Fixed a dark band above the message box when content scrolled beneath it.
